integrity: The lower bound is symbolic and field-independent. The bundled checker verifies the displayed multiplication table, annihilator, and second-center equations; finite computation is not used to infer the universal dimension bound.
scientific_limitations: The result gives the minimum dimension and one witness among finite-dimensional \(k\)-algebras with one bilinear multiplication. It does not classify all four-dimensional witnesses or settle identity-restricted subclasses.
title: Four dimensions are minimal for Grün failure in multilinear algebras
